name: take_message
description: Leave a message for the service writer/owner: after hours, estimate requests needing a human, unknown questions, failed transfers, or Haitian Creole callers who want a Creole-speaking callback. If it returns ok=false with invalid_input, re-ask for that field. If it returns timeout or internal_error, apologize and tell them someone from the shop will call them back.

reason.description: Short summary of what they need, in English

callback_language.description: Language for the callback: en, es, ht (Haitian Creole) or fr
